name: _triggers.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  draw-text/_triggers.scss — the reveal triggers: section-title mount,
//  active carousel slide, IntersectionObserver visibility, pending/done
//  states, and the related-mosaic write effect.
//  Imported by draw-text.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// NO will-change on char spans — promoting every char up-front creates a
// compositor layer per span before its staggered delay even starts (legal
// pages: hundreds of layers in one frame → dropped frames → chars landing
// in visible clumps). The browser promotes only the chars whose animation
// is actually running — see _mobile.scss for the same rationale.

// ── Section titles: animate on mount (replayed via :key re-mount) ──────────
.home-section-title .draw-text__char {
  animation: char-draw 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 100ms));
}

// ── Inside slides: animate only when the slide becomes active ──────────────
.aw-c-slide--active .draw-text__char {
  animation: char-draw 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 100ms));
}

// ── Viewport trigger: animate when scrolled into view ──────────────────────
// .draw-text--visible is added by IntersectionObserver in the component
.draw-text--visible .draw-text__char {
  animation: char-draw 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 100ms));
}

// Waiting for the viewport trigger: words rendered as plain nodes, kept invisible
.draw-text--pending {
  opacity: 0;
}

// Frozen state: animation complete, chars permanently visible, no re-trigger possible
.draw-text--done .draw-text__char {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
  filter: none;
  animation: none;
  will-change: auto; // release GPU layer after animation is done
}

// Done state restores the resting underline — the muted --grey line fades in
// via the border-bottom-color transition only after the whole text is drawn,
// and the ::after stays a hover sweep, never a resting line.
.draw-text--done a {
  border-bottom-color: var(--grey);
}

// ── Related Mosaic: animate write effect ─────────────────────────────────────
.related-mosaic-desc .draw-text__char {
  animation: char-draw 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 15ms));
}

// ── WebGPU overlay (rust/text-draw) ─────────────────────────────────────────
// While --gpu is on the content span, the overlay canvas repaints every
// glyph (one instanced draw for the whole stagger); the DOM char spans
// keep their CSS animation advancing underneath but paint nothing, so
// dropping the class at done-time lands on the identical rest state.
.draw-text--gpu .draw-text__char {
  visibility: hidden;
}

// The overlay canvas — the mount helper sizes/positions it inline over
// the content box (absolute against the host's relative box).
.draw-text__canvas {
  position: absolute;
  pointer-events: none;
}
